name: ciphervault
description: A secure token management application for multiple projects and environments

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.check: node --check electron-main.js && node --check preload.cjs && node --check vite.config.js && node --check src/main/crypto-utils.js && node --check src/main/ipc-validation.js && node --check src/main/keytar-manager.js && node --check src/main/realm-config.js && node --check src/main/secure-log-format.js && node --check src/main/secure-logger.js && node --check src/main/batch-delete.js && node --check src/main/renderer-security.js && node --check src/shared/keyboard-shortcuts.js && node --check src/shared/service-icons.js && node --check src/shared/token-search.js
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
